final: WITH station_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total FROM station_counts) SELECT station_counts.observstation, station_counts.record_count, CAST(station_counts.record_count AS REAL) / total_count.total FROM station_counts CROSS JOIN total_count WHERE total_count.total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST(station_counts.record_count AS REAL) / total_count.total DESC LIMIT 10
